scripts.marketplace:seed: bash scripts/with-activelane-env.sh go run ./go/cmd/alx seed --registry local --profile marketplace-demo --count 500 --seed 42
scripts.marketplace:seed:minimal: bash scripts/with-activelane-env.sh go run ./go/cmd/alx seed --registry local --profile minimal --count 12 --seed 42
scripts.marketplace:status: bash scripts/with-activelane-env.sh go run ./go/cmd/alx seed status --registry local
scripts.marketplace:clean: bash scripts/with-activelane-env.sh go run ./go/cmd/alx seed clean --registry local
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' --if-present run build:types && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' --filter desktop --if-present run typecheck
